scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build && node scripts/e2e-electron-smoke.mjs && node scripts/e2e-phase8-recovery-smoke.mjs && node scripts/e2e-phase8-exit-smoke.mjs && node scripts/e2e-phase10-resource-tabs.mjs && node scripts/e2e-phase12-settings-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:usability: pnpm run build && node scripts/e2e-phase13-usability.mjs && node scripts/e2e-electron-smoke.mjs

scripts.package:installer: pnpm run build && node scripts/stage-packaged-asr-runtime.mjs && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config electron-builder.yml --publish never && node scripts/write-release-checksum.mjs && node scripts/ci-package-smoke.mjs && node scripts/installer-smoke.mjs
